reviews.review: This game is actually really good despite what a lot of butt hurt fans say. I get that when it released it was really buggy, but its still a good game. I really hope they make a sequel to it.

This game is designed with one single purpose, to waste your time as much as possible. 

- Impossible console UI's
- Static "MMO" like world. NPCs basically do not react on completed quests or anything, they do not recognize you and continue with same routine as if the problem still existed
- Constant need for going back to base just to upgrade weapons or even to reequip
- Tons of useless dialogs, created first outpost and spend  about 2 hours in dialogs until I could move to next task
- Combat is weak and clunky, weapons feels same

I got pissed and uninstalled it because it had a weird static noise issue in the main menu and start of the game, tried browsing the issue and didn't find a solution..

pissed and the game almost exploded my ears, wouldn't reccomend.

This is actually a decent game for what it is. Removed from the original series it does stand  by itself. I bought the game when it first came out on Xbox one and gave up on it due to the bugs that plagued it. Loved falling through planets in an endless cycle. But now it's patched and playable. 

ONE THING TO NOTE: If you're having problems with cutscenes freezing or no dialogue/ awkward silence  (specific to US English, unsure how it impacts others), there is an extra patch that can be downloaded. The way I got it is by opening origin, right click the game icon and click game properties. Click the advance launch option tab and pick a different language. Save it/close out. Steam should have a 1.1GB update. After it's done downloading swap your language back to US English. The quiet/glitchy cutscenes should go back to normal.  This started for me right after becoming pathfinder and was able to fix it with the above.

If you played the original Mass Effect trilogy, it's worth a go. 
The original game's strengths were the story and characters, with the combat changing as the series grew. This game has really slick and fun combat, but I finished it 3 weeks ago and cannot tell you anything about the story. I enjoyed my time with it.
